id: \bI need to find a job. I'm not going to last long here without one.
en: \bI need to find a job. I'm not going to last long here without one.
it: \bDevo trovarmi un lavoro. Senza, qui non durerò a lungo.

id: \bNobody has ever come up here to visit me before. Thank you.
en: \bNobody has ever come up here to visit me before.  Thank you.
it: \bNessuno era mai salito fin quassù a trovarmi.  Grazie.

id: \bBe sure to keep things normal.
en: \bBe sure to keep things normal.
it: \bMi raccomando, mantieni tutto nella norma.

id: \rThe gym is inside the Pledging Tree. I think it's fitting for a Grass gym leader.
en: \rThe gym is inside the Pledging Tree. I think it's fitting for a Grass gym leader.
it: \rLa Palestra si trova dentro l'Albero della Promessa. Mi sembra adatto per un Capopalestra di tipo Erba.

id: \rSnivy
en: \rSnivy
it: \rSnivy

id: Coumarine City Pokémon Gym Leader:\nRamos
en: Coumarine City Pokémon Gym Leader:\nRamos
it: Capopalestra di Temperopoli:\nRamos

id: The old growth is still in bloom!
en: The old growth is still in bloom!
it: La vecchia pianta è ancora in fiore!

id: \rRoute 13 is a harsh desert. How that can be so close I have no idea.
en: \rRoute 13 is a harsh desert. How that can be so close I have no idea.
it: \rIl Percorso 13 è un deserto inospitale. Non ho idea di come possa essere così vicino.

id: \bI wish we would get rid of the railway and just walk across town like most towns.
en: \bI wish we would get rid of the railway and just walk across town like most towns.
it: \bVorrei che togliessero la ferrovia e che si attraversasse la città a piedi, come nella maggior parte dei posti.

id: \bThis place is too nice. Help me spread some crap around.
en: \bThis place is too nice. Help me spread some crap around.
it: \bQuesto posto è troppo bello. Aiutami a spargere un po' di schifezze in giro.

id: \bClemont: I've finally caught up to you. I wanted to tell you that the Lumiose Gym is almost finished with the repairs.
en: \bClemont: I've finally caught up to you. I wanted to tell you that the Lumiose Gym is almost finished with the repairs.
it: \bClemont: Finalmente ti ho raggiunto. Volevo dirti che le riparazioni della Palestra di Luminopoli sono quasi finite.

id: \rBonnie: Yea! That means you can fight my big brother.
en: \rBonnie: Yea! That means you can fight my big brother.
it: \rBonnie: Evviva! Vuol dire che potrai sfidare il mio fratellone.

id: \bI was actually thinking we could have a battle right now. Let me see how strong you've become since I last saw you. I'll show you my strength too.
en: \bI was actually thinking we could have a battle right now. Let me see how strong you've become since I last saw you. I'll show you my strength too.
it: \bIn realtà pensavo che potremmo fare una lotta adesso. Fammi vedere quanto sei diventato forte dall'ultima volta che ci siamo visti. Anch'io ti mostrerò la mia forza.

id: \bClemont: I think I know what I need to do now to prepare for our gym battle. I'll meet you in Lumiose City.
en: \bClemont: I think I know what I need to do now to prepare for our gym battle. I'll meet you in Lumiose City.
it: \bClemont: Credo di aver capito cosa devo fare per prepararmi alla nostra sfida in Palestra. Ci vediamo a Luminopoli.

id: \bNido
en: \bNido
it: \bNido

id: Coumarine City\nThe city where bay and butte are bound.
en: Coumarine City\nThe city where bay and butte are bound.
it: Temperopoli\nLa città dove baia e altura si incontrano.

id: \bMy late friend gave this to me. I can't carry it any longer though. I need to move on.
en: \bMy late friend gave this to me. I can't carry it any longer though. I need to move on.
it: \bMe l'ha dato un mio caro amico che non c'è più. Però non riesco più a portarlo con me. Devo andare avanti.

id: \bHis memory will last for me.
en: \bHis memory will last for me.
it: \bIl suo ricordo resterà con me.

id: \rBonnie: Hi \PN.
en: \rBonnie: Hi \PN.
it: \rBonnie: Ciao \PN.

id: \bTrevenant
en: \bTrevenant
it: \bTrevenant

id: \bIsn't my boat amazing?
en: \bIsn't my boat amazing?
it: \bLa mia barca non è fantastica?
